summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K (its ordinary foreign-private-issuer current report; US equivalent would be an 8-K) disclosing daily repurchases under its MAR safe-harbour share buyback programme initiated 6 May 2026, part of an up-to-DKK 15bn 12-month programme begun 4 February 2026. Since 26 October it bought 240,000 B shares daily at an average of DKK 257.51–267.29, accumulating 26,955,000 shares for DKK 7.76bn under the sub-programme and 41,714,179 shares for DKK 11.56bn since February. Treasury holdings now total 55,754,876 B shares, 1.2% of capital. Watch execution pace versus the DKK 11.2bn sub-limit and expiry 1 February 2027.
